pairs.description: Green tea extract dramatically reduces oral nadolol absorption, decreasing plasma drug concentrations by approximately 85 percent.
pairs.mechanism: Potent inhibition of intestinal Organic Anion Transporting Polypeptide 1A2 (OATP1A2) by epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG).

pairs.description: EGCG in green tea directly binds to the boronic acid moiety of bortezomib, completely inactivating its antineoplastic proteasome inhibitory action.
pairs.mechanism: Direct covalent cross-binding between 1,2-benzenediol groups of EGCG and the boronic acid group of bortezomib.

pairs.description: High consumption of brewed green tea containing vitamin K antagonizes warfarin's anticoagulant action, precipitating subtherapeutic INR levels.
pairs.mechanism: Direct pharmacodynamic antagonism of vitamin K epoxide reductase inhibition by exogenous phytomenadione in tea leaves.

pairs.description: Large quantities of green tea catechins can decrease bioavailability and peak plasma concentrations of atorvastatin.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of enteric influx transporters including OATP1A2 and OATP2B1 by green tea polyphenols.
